sources.title: Wabash National Corporation comments to FMCSA, Docket No. FMCSA-2016-0167
sources.effective_period: Assertion made in July 2016; no measurement period specified.
sources.locator: Page 1, paragraph beginning “As the largest trailer manufacturer in North America”
sources.note: Primary Wabash statement submitted in an official regulatory docket. It supports that Wabash made this claim in 2016, not an independently verified ranking or the unspecified/current wording.

sources.title: Trailer Output Report: 2023 | Trailer Body Builders
sources.locator: Article text on survey scope and methodology; extracted passage reports Hyundai Translead's 2023 output but provides no Wabash comparative rank.
sources.note: Secondary industry survey. The retrieved text does not establish Wabash's rank; its production figure and comparison with other manufacturers are not available in the extracted passage.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes CLI request configured for provider=openai-codex, model=gpt-6-luna, reasoning=xhigh, with web tools.
Research remained unresolved after focused searches; the user then directed that no further tool calls be made because the tool-calling iteration limit had been reached.
The 2016 ranking language is Wabash's own statement in a regulatory submission, not an agency finding.
The claim supplies no year, trailer-category boundary, ranking metric, or denominator.
The 2023 survey extract is incomplete for comparing Wabash with other manufacturers; its failure to establish Wabash's rank is not evidence that Wabash was not largest.
